summary: Level-5's PSP tactical RPG, later reissued for PS4 and PS5 with modern classic-emulation features.

entries.title: Jeanne d'Arc

emulation.emulator: PlayStation Classics emulator on PS4/PS5; PPSSPP for owned PSP copies
emulation.notes: Use the PS4/PS5 version for official up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and filters.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PSP presentation with official up-rendering and emulator conveniences.

primary.why: The PS4/PS5 release is the best official route because it converts the PSP game with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters, and it also made the game officially available in Europe.
primary.how_to_play: Buy or access Jeanne d'Arc on the PlayStation Store/PlayStation Plus Premium and play on PS5 or PS4. Use PSP hardware or PPSSPP only for original-hardware comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is an enhanced classic conversion, not a remake; converted classics may play differently in some cases.
